title: What Income Options Actually Means
hook: It's not just a list of side hustles - the term means something specific on Income Spectrum.
seo_keywords: income options for entrepreneurs, business platforms for independent workers, freelance and contract work platforms
script_line1: On Income Spectrum, Income Options is one of the main sections - and it refers specifically to platforms and pathways where you can actually start generating income as an independent worker or entrepreneur.
script_line2: Not advice about income. Not general tips. Actual platforms - places where you sign up, build a profile or listing, and connect with people who pay for what you do.
script_line3: The platforms span a few categories. Local service platforms like Angi Pro and Thumbtack. Digital and freelance like Fiverr and FlexJobs. Consulting and expert platforms like Clarity and Catalant.
script_line4: Commercial and property management platforms like MyVendorCenter and VendorPM. Teaching platforms like Outschool. Each platform has a card that tells you what it's for and how to get started.
script_line5: The framing is broader on purpose - some of these are serious business platforms, not just extra cash sources.
overlay_1: Income Options = real platforms to start earning
cta: Browse the Income Options section at incomespectrum.com - it's more organized than any list you've found so far.

title: What Are Supportive Services for a Business?
hook: Starting a business is one thing - having the infrastructure to run one is different.
seo_keywords: entrepreneur tools and resources, how to start earning independently, state business resources
script_line1: Supportive Services is a section on Income Spectrum that doesn't always get attention right away - but it matters more as you start actually building something.
script_line2: Supportive services are the tools and resources that help you set up and run a legitimate business. Business formation - actually registering as an LLC or other structure. Compliance tools.
script_line3: A lot of people focus on the income side - finding clients, joining platforms, making money - and they put off the structural stuff.
script_line4: Then they end up with income coming in but no business structure around it, which creates problems down the line.
script_line5: The Supportive Services section points you toward tools that make this easier. Not legal advice - tools and resources that help you handle the foundational stuff so you're operating like an actual business.
overlay_2: The infrastructure side of being a founder
cta: Check the Supportive Services section at incomespectrum.com - especially if you've been putting off the business structure side.

title: What Is a Service Role and Who Should Consider One?
hook: A service role is a specific type of independent income - and it's the right fit for more people than they realize.
seo_keywords: income options for entrepreneurs, founder identity, freelance and contract work platforms
script_line1: A service role is when the core of what you're selling is your time, expertise, or skill applied directly to a client's problem. Bookkeeping. Consulting. Home repair. Coaching.
script_line2: It's different from building a product, creating content to scale, or running a platform. In a service role, you are the service.
script_line3: That's not a limitation - for a lot of people it's actually the fastest path to real income because you don't need to build anything complicated. You just need to be good at something someone will pay for.
script_line4: Some people thrive in service roles - they like the direct client relationship, the hands-on work, the reliability of a recurring client base. Others find it draining. The Founder Identity Quiz helps sort this out.
script_line5: If you've been wondering whether you should just offer a service instead of trying to build something, the answer for a lot of people is yes - start there.
overlay_1: Service role = you are the product
overlay_2: Fastest path to income for the right founder type
cta: Take the Founder Identity Quiz at incomespectrum.app and see if a service role shows up as your best path.

title: What Are State and Federal Resources for Entrepreneurs?
hook: There's government money and support out there for small business owners - most people just don't know where to find it.
seo_keywords: state business resources, entrepreneur tools and resources, how to start earning independently
script_line1: State and federal resources for entrepreneurs are programs, funding, licensing information, and support services that exist through government channels - available to small business owners and independent workers, not just big companies.
script_line2: At the federal level - SBA programs, federal contracting opportunities, and information about federal business requirements. These apply regardless of which state you're in.
script_line3: At the state level it gets more specific. Many states have small business development programs. Some have grants or low-interest loan programs. State-specific licensing requirements for trades vary significantly.
script_line4: Income Spectrum has a dedicated page for every US state that pulls together what's relevant - licensing requirements, state programs, and pointers to where to go for more.
script_line5: A lot of independent workers completely skip this layer. They don't know it's there. Some of it is genuinely accessible, and not knowing about it means missing out on resources you've already paid for through taxes.
overlay_1: State programs + federal programs + licensing info
overlay_2: Every US state has a dedicated page on Income Spectrum
cta: Go to incomespectrum.com, click State and Federal Resources, and look up your state.

title: What Is the Founder File?
hook: Your Founder File is the output of the quiz - but it's meant to actually do something.
seo_keywords: founder identity, income path for beginners, income options for entrepreneurs
script_line1: When you take the Founder Identity Quiz on the Income Spectrum app, what you get back is your Founder File.
script_line2: The Founder File is your result profile. It tells you which founder type you most closely match - hands-on, digital, service-based, product-based, or some combination.
script_line3: But it's not just a label. The Founder File tells you which income platforms are most relevant to your type, points you toward certifications that make sense for where you're headed, and gives you a filter for the whole site.
script_line4: So instead of going to Income Spectrum and not knowing where to start, your Founder File basically says - here's your category, here's where to look first.
script_line5: The quiz is free, the Founder File is free, and the whole point is to make your exploration feel less like searching in the dark.

overlay_2: Generated from the Founder Identity Quiz
